summary: Leading development of enterprise AI platforms (hcms.ai) for the UAE government, enabling workforce intelligence, skill gap analysis, and AI-driven recruitment at scale. Architected scalable frontend and backend systems with React.js, Vue.js, Node.js and Nest.js, drove the AWS-to-Azure migration, and built secure, event-driven architectures using Azure Functions, Blob Storage, App Service and Queue with CI/CD pipelines.

Translated business requirements into scalable, OOP-based solutions across a React Native mobile app and React-based admin portal. Designed Node.js backend architecture using SOLID design patterns, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL and Redis for high-performance microservices, built infrastructure on AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, SQS, CodeDeploy, CloudFormation) with Docker, and prototyped generative AI solutions with AWS Bedrock (Claude Sonnet).
Built frontend and backend APIs for multiple projects using Node.js, React.js and MySQL, and contributed to deep learning model training and deployment for an e-commerce application.
